stories.title: AI labs want in-house auditors — but maybe they should shut the front door first
stories.simple_summary: AI companies are talking about hiring people to check if their AI systems behave properly, but the article suggests there might be simpler fixes they're missing.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to AI companies and investors right now — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Your AI agents can now control your Google Home devices
stories.simple_summary: Google is letting AI assistants (like Claude and ChatGPT) control your smart home devices, like turning lights on or checking security cameras, just by asking them in plain language.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use Google Home devices and AI assistants, this could make controlling your smart home easier — but it's still early and only for paid users.

stories.title: Google DeepMind Co-Founder Shane Legg Joins Safety-First Camp in AI Debate
stories.simple_summary: A co-founder of a major AI lab is joining discussions about making sure AI is developed safely.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly about industry debates among experts — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Poll shows Americans are increasingly alarmed by AI’s ecological footprint
stories.simple_summary: A poll found that many Americans are worried about how much electricity and environmental resources AI systems use up.
stories.why_it_matters: This reflects growing public concern, but it doesn't change what you can do today.

stories.title: House Democrats call to cancel upcoming recess for time to legislate on AI
stories.simple_summary: Some members of Congress want to skip their vacation to work on new laws about AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This means government is taking AI regulation seriously, but it's too early to know what rules might actually affect you.

stories.title: Anthropic merges Claude chat and Cowork in one interface
stories.simple_summary: Anthropic (a company that makes Claude, an AI assistant) is combining two of its tools into one easier-to-use package for paid subscribers.
stories.why_it_matters: If you pay for Claude, this might make it slightly more convenient — but it's a small update.

stories.title: Pentagon CTO says U.S. government shouldn't take stakes in tech giants, questions adding AI rules
stories.simple_summary: A Pentagon official said the U.S. government shouldn't buy stock in big tech companies and questioned whether new AI rules are needed.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mainly about government policy debates — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: ‘Godfather of AI’ says tech regulation is nearing Covid-style pivot moment
stories.simple_summary: A famous AI researcher says that how governments regulate AI might be about to shift direction, like what happened with Covid policies.
stories.why_it_matters: This is expert commentary about possible future regulation — too uncertain to affect your decisions today.

stories.title: Robots are waiting for a ChatGPT moment: Nvidia’s Les Karpas explains why at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
stories.simple_summary: A tech company executive says the robotics industry is waiting for its big breakthrough moment, like when ChatGPT suddenly became popular.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly an invitation to a tech conference — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: The sexy AI-powered dating app scams are here
stories.simple_summary: Scammers are creating fake dating apps that use AI to chat with people and trick them into sending money or personal information.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use dating apps, be extra careful — if someone you just matched with asks for money or personal details, it's almost certainly a scam.

stories.title: Threads’ new features let podcasters promote shows and reach listeners
stories.simple_summary: Meta's Threads social network is adding new tools to help podcast creators promote their shows and reach listeners.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're a podcaster, this gives you a new way to promote — but only if you already use Threads.

stories.title: Next wave of VCs judging Startup Battlefield 200 contenders at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 revealed
stories.simple_summary: A tech conference is announcing the judges for a startup competition.
stories.why_it_matters: This is only relevant if you're pitching a startup to investors — nothing you need to act on.
